review_limits: No costs, group/version mapping, RUN_RESULT or raw cells were read. Tool methods themselves reveal a route; no version/group is inferred.
No new formal-proof requirement, mandatory hole wording, or redundant native confirmation of valid plugin facts was added.
Initial/final/source/close checks are supplied in anonymous packets. Root is responsible for comparing their original same-version and state receipts after this score is frozen.
Missing graceful EXIT from thin client bridges remains a transport exit evidence limitation, distinct from backend close/known process cleanup; it is not classified as an incorrect geometry answer.

Code inspection and unchanged final geometry support readonly compliance; final equality alone would not prove absence of every possible transient operation. No such operation was found in the inspected calls.
Four unsupported nearest_witness task requests were rejected before mutation and corrected. Their failed attempts remain in evidence and must remain in total cost accounting.
